text.tspan: A Life That Lives Christ (Forbearance Song)
Each moment and instance by God is assigned,
Fulfilling our purpose to gain our rich Christ.
Anxiety from Satan in us has no ground.
We live Christ to others, in Him we’ll be found.
Forbearance from God is a Person so dear.
By prayer and petition our burdens He hears.
Be anxious in nothing, with thanks we must pray,
And speak with the Lord, this is the secret way.
In God’s life there’s rest and enjoyment and peace,
For fear and anxiety in us now has ceased.
Continually speaking with Christ, He’s so near.
He’s ready to help us, His presence so dear.
